title: Embedded Systems & IoT
shortDescription: Design intelligent hardware-software systems that interact with the physical world. From edge computing to sensor networks, build solutions that bridge silicon and reality.

problemStatements.title: Predictive Maintenance for Industrial Machinery
problemStatements.description: Industrial downtime costs billions annually. Design an embedded system that monitors vibration, temperature, and current draw of rotating machinery in real time to predict failure before it occurs.
objectives: Develop a low-power embedded data acquisition unit using a microcontroller of your choice
Implement signal processing algorithms to extract meaningful features from raw sensor data
Build a lightweight on-device ML inference engine for anomaly detection
Design a dashboard for plant operators showing health scores and predicted time-to-failure
deliverables: Functional prototype with at least three sensor modalities
Documented firmware source code with unit tests
A trained model with accuracy benchmarks on a provided test dataset
A two-page technical report describing architecture decisions
evaluationCriteria: Prediction accuracy on the evaluation dataset (30%)

problemStatements.title: Smart Agriculture Water Management
problemStatements.description: Water scarcity is a growing crisis. Build an IoT-based precision irrigation system that monitors soil moisture, weather conditions, and crop type to optimize water usage at the field level.
objectives: Deploy a wireless sensor network across a simulated field layout
Implement a central controller that aggregates data and makes irrigation decisions
Integrate a weather API to factor in forecasted rainfall
Build a farmer-facing mobile-friendly interface for remote monitoring
deliverables: Working prototype with minimum four sensor nodes
Backend server for data aggregation and decision logic
Documented API and system architecture diagram
Live demo on a test bed or simulated environment
evaluationCriteria: System reliability and uptime during demo (30%)

problemStatements.title: Low-Power Indoor Positioning System
problemStatements.description: GPS fails indoors. Design a sub-meter accurate indoor positioning system using BLE, UWB, or visible light communication for use in hospitals, warehouses, or campuses.
objectives: Prototype an anchor and tag hardware setup
Implement a trilateration or fingerprinting algorithm for position estimation
Achieve positioning error under 1.5 meters in a test environment
Demonstrate a real-time map view showing tag positions
deliverables: Hardware prototype with at least three anchors and one tracked tag
Position calculation algorithm source code
Accuracy report with CDF plot of positioning error
Use-case demonstration in a defined scenario
evaluationCriteria: Power consumption of the tag unit (25%)

problemStatements.title: Edge AI for Real-Time Fall Detection
problemStatements.description: Falls are the leading cause of injury among the elderly. Build an edge-deployed wearable that detects falls in real time using IMU data and immediately notifies caregivers.
objectives: Design or select a wearable form factor with an IMU sensor
Train and quantize a neural network for fall vs non-fall classification
Deploy the model on a microcontroller with under 100ms inference latency
Implement an alert pipeline via BLE or Wi-Fi to a caregiver's device
deliverables: Wearable prototype or functional simulation
Trained and quantized model with confusion matrix
Latency benchmark report
End-to-end demo from fall event to caregiver notification
evaluationCriteria: Classification accuracy and false alarm rate (35%)

problemStatements.title: Autonomous Line-Following Robot with Obstacle Intelligence
problemStatements.description: Extend the classic line-follower into an intelligent autonomous unit. The robot must navigate a defined track, handle intersections, avoid dynamic obstacles, and optimize its lap time.
objectives: Build a line-following chassis with PID-based motor control
Add ultrasonic or IR obstacle detection with avoidance maneuvers
Implement intersection decision logic based on external signals or onboard state
Log telemetry for post-run analysis
deliverables: Physical robot prototype
Firmware source code with documented state machine
Telemetry log from a timed run
Short video demonstration of a full track run

title: Signal Processing & AI
shortDescription: Harness data, signals, and intelligence to solve problems in healthcare, communications, and beyond. Build systems that extract meaning from noise.

problemStatements.title: Arrhythmia Detection from ECG Signals
problemStatements.description: Cardiovascular disease is the world's leading cause of death. Build a signal processing and ML pipeline that accurately detects arrhythmia patterns from raw ECG recordings.
objectives: Preprocess ECG signals including noise filtering and baseline correction
Implement a QRS detection algorithm and extract time-domain features
Train a classifier on a provided labelled ECG dataset
Deploy the pipeline as a web or desktop tool for clinical review
deliverables: Signal processing and feature extraction pipeline
Trained classifier with precision, recall, and F1 metrics
Interactive visualization of flagged arrhythmia segments
Technical documentation and model card
evaluationCriteria: Classifier performance on held-out test data (35%)
Signal processing quality and noise robustness (25%)

problemStatements.title: Noise-Robust Speech Enhancement for Telemedicine
problemStatements.description: Poor audio quality during teleconsultations leads to misdiagnosis. Design a real-time speech enhancement system that suppresses ambient noise while preserving clinical speech quality.
objectives: Implement a spectral subtraction or deep-learning based noise suppression algorithm
Evaluate performance using PESQ and STOI metrics on a noisy speech dataset
Achieve real-time processing on a CPU with under 20ms added latency
Build a demo interface for side-by-side comparison of raw and enhanced audio
deliverables: Enhancement algorithm source code
Benchmark report with PESQ and STOI scores
Real-time demo application
Analysis of trade-offs between latency and quality
evaluationCriteria: Objective quality metrics on the evaluation set (35%)
Demo quality and ease of use (25%)

problemStatements.title: Multi-Speaker Diarization for Meeting Transcripts
problemStatements.description: Who said what? Build an automated speaker diarization system that segments and labels an audio recording by speaker identity, enabling accurate meeting transcription.
objectives: Implement voice activity detection to isolate speech segments
Extract speaker embeddings using a pre-trained or custom model
Cluster segments into per-speaker timelines
Generate a timestamped diarized transcript
deliverables: Full diarization pipeline source code
Diarization Error Rate (DER) on a provided evaluation set
Sample transcripts from multi-speaker test recordings
System architecture document

problemStatements.title: Spectrum Sensing for Cognitive Radio
problemStatements.description: Radio spectrum is scarce. Design a cognitive radio system that senses the radio environment, detects primary user activity, and dynamically selects idle frequency bands for secondary use.
objectives: Implement energy detection and cyclostationary feature detection algorithms
Simulate a primary user activity model across multiple channels
Build a decision engine that selects the optimal channel for transmission
Evaluate detection probability and false alarm rate under varying SNR
deliverables: Simulation environment source code
ROC curves for the detection algorithms
Channel selection performance analysis
Report on practical deployment considerations
evaluationCriteria: Sensing latency and channel switch time (25%)

problemStatements.title: Retinal Disease Screening from Fundus Images
problemStatements.description: Diabetic retinopathy is a leading cause of preventable blindness. Build a deep learning system that screens fundus photographs for signs of diabetic retinopathy and grades their severity.
objectives: Preprocess and augment a fundus image dataset for training
Fine-tune or train a CNN architecture for multi-class grading
Implement Grad-CAM for explainable visualizations of model decisions
Deploy as a web app where clinicians can upload an image and receive a graded report
deliverables: Trained model weights and training code
Grading accuracy and confusion matrix on a test set
Grad-CAM visualizations for sample predictions
Clinical-facing web application
evaluationCriteria: Quality and interpretability of Grad-CAM maps (25%)
Clinical utility of the web interface (25%)
